Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. ### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

## PR Description

Closes #829
## gh-829 — CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation

### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

### Test Coverage
- RED first: new `gh-829` suite in `test_smGithubSource.js` fails on the pre-fix engine (CLEAN heads arm indiscriminately; pr-826 invisible to every arming rule).
- Matrix L1: labels × mergeState × latch — 15-PR wave pinning AC1/AC2/AC3, fail-closed fetch, unlinked PR, BLOCKED-branch parity, drafts, checks-none lane.
- `test_smAgent.js` config assertions updated to the deployed rule shape.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

    "description": "## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. - No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## gh-829 — CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation

### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

- RED first: new `gh-829` suite in `test_smGithubSource.js` fails on the pre-fix engine (CLEAN heads arm indiscriminately; pr-826 invisible to every arming rule).
- Matrix L1: labels × mergeState × latch — 15-PR wave pinning AC1/AC2/AC3, fail-closed fetch, unlinked PR, BLOCKED-branch parity, drafts, checks-none lane.
- `test_smAgent.js` config assertions updated to the deployed rule shape.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. ### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

### Test Coverage
- RED first: new `gh-829` suite in `test_smGithubSource.js` fails on the pre-fix engine (CLEAN heads arm indiscriminately; pr-826 invisible to every arming rule).
- Matrix L1: labels × mergeState × latch — 15-PR wave pinning AC1/AC2/AC3, fail-closed fetch, unlinked PR, BLOCKED-branch parity, drafts, checks-none lane.
- `test_smAgent.js` config assertions updated to the deployed rule shape.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. ## gh-829 — CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation

### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

### Test Coverage
- RED first: new `gh-829` suite in `test_smGithubSource.js` fails on the pre-fix engine (CLEAN heads arm indiscriminately; pr-826 invisible to every arming rule).
- Matrix L1: labels × mergeState × latch — 15-PR wave pinning AC1/AC2/AC3, fail-closed fetch, unlinked PR, BLOCKED-branch parity, drafts, checks-none lane.
- `test_smAgent.js` config assertions updated to the deployed rule shape.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

## gh-829 — CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation

### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

- RED first: new `gh-829` suite in `test_smGithubSource.js` fails on the pre-fix engine (CLEAN heads arm indiscriminately; pr-826 invisible to every arming rule).
- Matrix L1: labels × mergeState × latch — 15-PR wave pinning AC1/AC2/AC3, fail-closed fetch, unlinked PR, BLOCKED-branch parity, drafts, checks-none lane.
- `test_smAgent.js` config assertions updated to the deployed rule shape.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

## gh-829 — CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation

### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

### Test Coverage
- RED first: new `gh-829` suite in `test_smGithubSource.js` fails on the pre-fix engine (CLEAN heads arm indiscriminately; pr-826 invisible to every arming rule).
- Matrix L1: labels × mergeState × latch — 15-PR wave pinning AC1/AC2/AC3, fail-closed fetch, unlinked PR, BLOCKED-branch parity, drafts, checks-none lane.
- `test_smAgent.js` config assertions updated to the deployed rule shape.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

## PR Description

Closes #829
## gh-829 — CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation

### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

### Test Coverage
- RED first: new `gh-829` suite in `test_smGithubSource.js` fails on the pre-fix engine (CLEAN heads arm indiscriminately; pr-826 invisible to every arming rule).
- Matrix L1: labels × mergeState × latch — 15-PR wave pinning AC1/AC2/AC3, fail-closed fetch, unlinked PR, BLOCKED-branch parity, drafts, checks-none lane.
- `test_smAgent.js` config assertions updated to the deployed rule shape.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. ### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

### Test Coverage
- RED first: new `gh-829` suite in `test_smGithubSource.js` fails on the pre-fix engine (CLEAN heads arm indiscriminately; pr-826 invisible to every arming rule).
- Matrix L1: labels × mergeState × latch — 15-PR wave pinning AC1/AC2/AC3, fail-closed fetch, unlinked PR, BLOCKED-branch parity, drafts, checks-none lane.
- `test_smAgent.js` config assertions updated to the deployed rule shape.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.

Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Closes #829
## gh-829 — CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation

### Root Cause
`validate-fresh-masked-green` (gh-759) matches green zero-label heads only when mergeState is BLOCKED — CLEAN was excluded ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"). But `merge-validated` requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated, so a fresh machine PR that is CLEAN + green + zero labels matched no rule and rotted (live: PR #826, hours idle).

### Fix
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — new query guard `mergeStateLatch`: a listed merge state matches ONLY when the PR's linked issue carries the latch label(s), read via the existing per-tick TTL issue-label cache; fails CLOSED (no linked issue / fetch failure / missing label ⇒ state excluded, exactly like the old `notMergeState`).
- `sm_github.json` — `validate-fresh-masked-green`: `notMergeState` drops CLEAN (now `[BEHIND, DIRTY]`), adds `"mergeStateLatch": {"CLEAN": ["ai_developed"]}`. CLEAN + green + zero lifecycle labels + the issue's `ai_developed` latch (AC1) flows through the unchanged `validate_pr` probe → dispatch + arm; `skipIfGreenCi` stays. The BLOCKED branch is untouched — still author-agnostic, no latch, no issue fetch (gh-757 contract).
- AC2: all five lifecycle labels stay in `notLabels` — every existing rule keeps its lane. AC3: guest/unlinked PRs without the latch stay unarmed (fail closed).

### Test Coverage
- RED first: new `gh-829` suite in `test_smGithubSource.js` fails on the pre-fix engine (CLEAN heads arm indiscriminately; pr-826 invisible to every arming rule).
- Matrix L1: labels × mergeState × latch — 15-PR wave pinning AC1/AC2/AC3, fail-closed fetch, unlinked PR, BLOCKED-branch parity, drafts, checks-none lane.
- `test_smAgent.js` config assertions updated to the deployed rule shape.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2253 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (replay of #826's 5h timeline) and L3 (live) verify in deployment; the unit wave reproduces the exact #826 shape (green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` latch).
- No new API pressure: the latch reuses the 60s issue-label cache already maintained for priority tiers.

# gh-829: [GOAL] CLEAN + green + ZERO-labels machine PR never arms validation — dead-zone family misses the CLEAN case (dmtools-agents PR #826 sat idle)

## Description

## Goal

A freshly-created machine PR whose head is CLEAN with GREEN checks and ZERO labels must get validation armed in the same tick — the gh-757/759 dead-zone family only covers BLOCKED heads, so CLEAN+green+no-labels PRs are never armed and rot.

## Subject

Tick arming rules: `validate-fresh` (checks none/pending) and the gh-759 `validate-unarmed-green` (green + BLOCKED). Both exclude CLEAN — deliberately ("merge-validated owns CLEAN"), but merge-validated requires `pr_approved`, which a zero-label PR can never reach without first being validated. The exclusion assumed SOME rule covers the CLEAN+no-labels case; none does.

Live instance 2026-10-10: dmtools-agents PR #826 (issue gh-825 latch `ai_developed` present, PR all-green, CLEAN, zero labels for hours — no `ai_validating`, no review, nothing; owner flagged it as "не двигается").

## Capability surface

- Extend `validate-unarmed-green` (gh-759): drop the CLEAN exclusion for the ZERO-LABEL case only — green + not-BEHIND + none of `ai_validating/pr_approved/ai_validated/chore:pin/validation_failed` + PR's issue carries `ai_developed` ⇒ probe for a dispatched CI run (existing logic) ⇒ dispatch + arm.
- KEEP the notMergeState exclusions for BEHIND/DIRTY as today (silent-update/conflict paths own those).
- The `skipIfGreenCi` guard stays (green completed run covers head ⇒ skip, log why).

## Acceptance criteria

1. AC1: sim — fresh machine PR, green ambient checks, CLEAN, zero labels, `ai_developed` issue latch ⇒ one tick arms `ai_validating` + dispatches validation.
2. AC2: a PR with ANY lifecycle label is untouched by this rule (all existing rules keep their disjointness).
3. AC3: guest-authored PRs without the latch stay unarmed (machine-author gating as today).
4. AC4: live — #826-class occurrence arms within one tick, no manual intervention.

## Test plan

- L1: unit tests (match/no-match matrix over labels × mergeState × latch).
- L2: replay #826's timeline (green+CLEAN+zero labels ~5h) — new rule arms at tick 1.
- L3 (live): next fresh dev PR arms promptly.

## Non-goals

- Changing kicker/ambient-check behavior.
- The thread-resolution card (#828) — independent.

## References

- gh-756/#757/#759 dead-zone family (fa #1305-#1312, #922 instances).
- Instance: dmtools-agents PR #826, 2026-10-10.
